question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Marine vertebrates are / valuable for / many reasons.
solution:
The correct answer is **"No error".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **"Marine vertebrates"** is a **plural noun** and we use **plural noun** with the **plural verb** which is given in the question **"are".**
 
• In Subject-verb agreement, we use a singular verb with a singular noun or pronoun or do verb change as per the tense and a plural verb with a plural noun or pronoun.​
 
 
• Example: *They have elected a new president.*
 
 
 
• Also, we use **plural countable nouns** with **"many" **which is also correctly given in the question.
 
• So, there is no error in the sentence.

 

Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

Complete Sentence__:* **Marine vertebrates are valuable for many reasons.*
